s: Which famous work was written by Allasani Peddana?
x:
Allasani Peddana, honoured as the Andhra Kavita Pitamaha, was the foremost among the Ashtadiggajas in the court of Sri Krishnadevaraya. His masterpiece, Manu Charitramu (Svarochisha Manu Sambhavam), is regarded as one of the greatest works of Telugu literature. The work narrates the story of Svarochisha Manu, blending mythology with poetic imagination and philosophical thought. Because of his literary excellence, Krishnadevaraya honoured Allasani Peddana with exceptional respect, and he came to be known as the greatest poet of the Vijayanagara period. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).

s: During the rule of Sri Krishnadevaraya, the 'Kandacharya' department looked into these matters?
x:
During the Vijayanagara administration, the Kandacharya was an important official connected with the military department. The Kandacharya supervised military organization, recruitment, maintenance of troops, inspection of armed forces and other defence-related responsibilities. Since the Vijayanagara Empire maintained a powerful standing army, this office occupied an important place in the administrative system. The military strength of the empire was one of the major reasons for its success against the Bahmani Sultanate and other contemporary powers. Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).

s: In ancient medieval times Pradvivaka was the advisor to the king in this department?
x:
The Pradvivaka (Pradvivaka or Pradvivakudu) was the chief judicial adviser to the king in ancient and medieval Indian administration. He assisted the ruler in legal matters, interpreted Dharmashastra, advised on judicial decisions and supervised the administration of justice. His position was equivalent to that of a chief judge or legal expert in the royal court. Several ancient legal texts refer to the office of the Pradvivaka as an important component of judicial administration. Hence, the correct answer is Option (4).
